sources.text: Search this site Embedded Files Field Research Lab Linguistics Field Research Lab Welcome! We are faculty and students dedicated to the teaching and research of underdocumented and understudied languages. We are currently engaged in research projects with members of language communities, including: Amahuaca (Panoan), Choguita Rarámuri (Uto-Aztecan), San Juan Piñas Mixtec (Oto-Manguean), Diné Bizaad (Athabaskan), Rere, Tira and Moro (Kordofanian), Teotepec Eastern Chatino (Oto-Manguean), Wyandot (Iroquoian), Irish Gaelic (Celtic), Ket (Yeniseian) and Azerbaijani (Turkic). We are committed to linguistic description and collaborative language documentation projects whose products serve both linguists and communities. Many of our research projects have arisen through our Field Methods/Fieldwork classes, both undergraduate and graduate: 202 6 : Comachuén Purépecha ( isolate, Mexico ) 2024: Tigre (Semitic, Eritrea) 2023: Southern Uzbek (Turkic, Afghanistan) 2022: Ekegusii (Bantu, Kenya ) 2022: San Juan Piñas Mixtec (Oto-Manguean; Mexico) 2021: Todos Santos Cuchumatán Mam (Mayan; Guatemala) 2020: San Juan Piñas Mixtec (Oto-Manguean; Mexico) and Todos Santos Cuchumatán Mam (Mayan; Guatemala) 2018, 2019: Koalib (Rere - ŋ̀rɛ́ɛ́ɽɛ̀) (Kordofanian; Sudan) and San Juan Piñas Mixtec (Oto-Manguean; Mexico) 2016: Ja'a Kumiai (Yuman; Mexico) 2015: Bari (Nilotic; South Sudan) 2012, 2013: Ixpantepec Nieves Mixtec (Oto-Manguean; Mexico) 2011: Purépecha (isolate; Mexico) 2010: GiTonga (Bantu; Mozambique) 2005, 2006: Moro (Kordofanian; Sudan) Find out about who we are , our working group , our projects , and recent news and events below. Recent News and Events Anthony Struthers-Young to Princeton Anthony Struthers-Young (PhD 2025) is now a post-doctoral researcher in Linguistics at Princeton University. JJ Lim to CSU San Marcos JJ Lim (PhD 2025) is now a Lecturer in Liberal Studies at California State University, San Marcos. Ray Huaute to UCLA Ray Huaute (PhD 2023) completed a two-year UC President 's P ostdoc toral Fe llowship at UC Riverside and is now a tenure -track Assistant Professor in the American Indian Studies department at UCLA.
